fields.label: Service
fields.default: social content strategy and social media post creation
fields.fallback_instruction: Fixed to the operational execution service (content pillars, editorial/content calendar, post copywriting, graphic design, scheduling/publishing). Only include companies with a genuine strategy-to-execution pipeline: pillar/calendar planning AND actual post creation (copy, design, video) AND ideally scheduling/publishing. Paid-social-ads-only pages do not count.
fields.raw_explanation: service: "social content strategy" and "social media post creation" — the operational execution service.

fields.label: Location
fields.fallback_instruction: Defaults to Australia-wide if not specified, boosting local leaders if provided. Genuine local presence must be verified (phone number, office address, or other locale-specific evidence) — auto-localised international pages must be excluded even if topically strong.
fields.raw_explanation: {LOCATION}, or Australia-wide if not specified, boosting local leaders if provided.

fields.label: Competitor Type
fields.fallback_instruction: If missing or empty, include both types.
fields.raw_explanation: "niche_specialist" = a company specialised in social content strategy and post creation as its core offer. "full_stack_niche" = a full-service company in the same industry as the target that prominently offers social content strategy and post creation as a distinct, structured service.
